I answered Marcus in a thread reply in #north-team: the main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

That comes from Dana's message in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, and Marcus is a member of that channel. Dana wrote that Thea had flagged the duplicates again on the morning shift. They were the same trailer logged twice at 06:30, once from the kiosk and once when dispatch added it by hand.

The account's file folder came back empty, so I had no CRM record to check this against.
